summary: CBRE Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary CBRE Services, Inc. closed a $750M offering of 5.250% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes were issued under a base indenture supplemented by a thirteenth supplemental indenture and are fully guaranteed by CBRE Group. Proceeds will repay commercial paper borrowings. The offering was underwritten by Wells Fargo, BofA, Citigroup and Scotia Capital. No special situation is present; this is a routine debt issuance.
